sentences.text:
Also heard Mr.
B. Sarma, learned Addl. Public Prosecutor, Assam appearing for the State Page No.# 2/3 respondent No.1.
None appears for the respondent No.2.

By this petition under Section 439 Cr.P.C., the accused petitioner, namely Gopal Gautam has prayed for grant of bail in connection with Special (POCSO) Case No. 9/2023 pending in the Court of learned Sessions Judge, West Karbi Anglong, Hamren corresponding Baithalangso PS Case No.
88/2022 under Sections 376(1)/506/370(1)/ 370(3)/120B of IPC read with Sections 4/6/17 of the Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012.

entities.text: Court of learned Sessions Judge, West Karbi Anglong, Hamren
entities.label: COURT

entities.text: Protection of Children from Sexual Offences Act, 2012
entities.label: STATUTE

sentences.text: The scanned copy of case record, as called for, is placed before the Court.

The FIR reveals the allegation that in the month of February, 2022, the accused petitioner lured the daughter of the informant aged about 17 years to his house and thereafter, committed rape on her on two occasions by confining her in his house and threatening her not to disclose the matter to anyone.

When the informant came to know that his daughter was pregnant and enquired about the matter, the friends of the accused petitioner threatened him and the accused petitioner took the victim to Polyclinic Hospital at Guwahati where she gave birth to a male child on 09.10.2022.
It is noticed that the accused petitioner has been in judicial custody since 18.11.2022, that is, for 335 days.

A perusal of the record shows that a charge sheet under Section 376(2)(f) of the IPC read with Section 6 of the POCSO Act against the accused petitioner was submitted and accordingly, after consideration of the materials on record, the learned trial Court framed charges vide order, dated 11.08.2023.
Thereafter, 2(two) material prosecution witnesses (informant and victim girl who is stated to be aged about 17 years) are examined out of 13(thirteen) listed witnesses.
There is no possibility of completion of recording evidence of all the remaining prosecution witnesses at an early date.
On the other hand, the DNA profiling could not be done as reported by the investigating officer vide report, dated 16.10.2023.

The accused petitioner is stated to be aged about 52 years and a permanent resident under Baithalangso P.S. and as Page No.# 3/3 such, this Court finds that there is no possibility of the accused jumping the course of trial of the case, if he is released on bail subject to conditions.

For the above stated reasons, it is provided that the accused petitioner, named above, shall be released on bail of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty thousand) only with one surety of like amount to the satisfaction of the learned Special Judge (POCSO Act), Hamren, West Karbi Anglong, Assam subject to the following conditions- i) That the accused petitioner shall continue to appear before the learned trial Court on all dates to be fixed from time to time till the case is disposed of; and ii) That the accused petitioner shall not directly or indirectly make any inducement, threat or promise to the remaining prosecution witnesses, who are acquainted with the facts of the case so as Gopal Gautam vs The State Of Assam And Anr on 18 October, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/173863814/
2 to dissuade him/her from disclosing such facts to the Court.
Breach of the above two conditions shall render cancellation of the bail in accordance with law.
This disposes of the bail application.
JUDGE
